result.title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
result.summary: Sparse MoE mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. However, practical deployment still requires storing all experts, resulting in substantial memory overhead. We show that expert outputs in MoE layers exhibit structured redundancy. Across different models and task categories, the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts, while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. Motivated by these observations, we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy, rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. We propose two expert pruning methods under the unified structure-preserving framework: Projection Energy Expert Pruning (PEEP), which preserves the functional subspace by maximizing weighted projection energy, and Distributional Coverage Expert Pruning (DCEP), which preserves the distributional geometry by minimizing weighted coverage error. Both methods incorporate router-derived weights as priors, enabling them to jointly preserve the global structural relationships among experts while accounting for the local importance of individual experts. Experiments on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate that, at the expert retention ratios of 75% and 50%, our methods outperform the state-of-the-art baselines on the majority of benchmarks and consistently achieve the best average performance across both general tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 MoE 层专家输出存在结构化冗余：稳定秩与熵有效秩远低于名义专家数、有效模态数偏少；据此把专家剪枝重述为结构保持的子集选择问题，用贪心策略提出 PEEP（最大化加权投影能量以保留功能子空间）与 DCEP（最小化加权覆盖误差以保留分布几何），并把 router 权重作为先验，在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以稳定秩、熵有效秩刻画内部表示的有效维度与冗余，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态是否同样低有效秩且存在结构化冗余，而按子空间能量与分布覆盖选取保留成分的做法或可启发动机 latent 工作区的表示筛选与容量分配；但论文本身属纯文本 MoE 压缩，与视觉多模态推理无直接关联。
